css-flex-basis.name: just makes them grow, retaining different base widths

css-flex-shrink.name: makes the two items shrink together and the button becomes narrower

css-flex-auto-margin.name: divides all buttons evenly, and the buttons on the left are no longer grouped

css-flex-align-content.name: mistakenly writes row distribution as align-items

css-grid-implicit-rows.name: only appends an explicit line, and the next line returns to the default height

css-grid-min-content.name: only compresses column width, long file names still overflow

css-grid-self-alignment.name: only performs horizontal alignment, but is still stretched in the vertical direction.

css-float-clear.name: Only let the picture float, the title of the next section still starts next to the picture

css-fixed-position.name: Use absolute to make the link scroll with the text

css-stacking.name: The background layer is higher than the status label

css-flex-footer.name: Fixed footer to remove it from document flow

css-object-fit.name: Use contain to leave the box blank

css-aspect-ratio.name: uses fixed height, only correct in one of the widths

css-calc-sizing.name: does not deduct white space, narrow screen card welt

css-clamp-text.name: only writes the font size that changes with the viewport and lacks borders.

css-container-query.name: uses viewport media query, and the narrow columns become horizontal

css-logical-spacing.name: The left side is hard-coded, and the starting edge of the reverse page is wrong.

css-reduced-motion.name: in turn turns off the animation when there is no reduction preference
